title: Per-map performance audit after the map rounds (47-57)

trees.fixedBranch: 3fba2df4c (terrain: dry-marsh field-trench plan cached) on r59-perf-audit

method: tools/tmp-r59-map-perf-probe.mjs (throwaway over tools/map-probe-runtime.mjs): desktop tier, seed 1337, t90m_x, solo battle per map on a private vite server; activation trace (__WORLD_LOAD) build stages; long tasks from document start; bots frozen; sourced textures awaited; chase / bird (hull-relative) and edge-e-low / centre-far (view table) poses, 90 rendered frames each: main-thread ms per frame, GPU ms (EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2, command-buffer granular on ANGLE Metal: supporting evidence only), renderer.info calls / triangles; scene inventory (instances per subsystem, texture / geometry byte estimates, programs). Every map measured main -> base -> main -> base in one process under one hold of the probe mutex at nice 19 while sibling lanes kept the 1-minute load at 5-20: wall-clock rows carry their load1; counts, programs and stage ratios are the decisive signals. Chunk-1 verdant/desert rows re-measured (foreign tsc burst at load 12-14); skybridge / blackglass pairs re-run (host drift). Means over the runs per tree.
columns: build/total ms = __WORLD_LOAD build / totalMs; chase*/bird*/edge*/far* = median per-frame main-thread (cpu) and GPU ms at that pose; calls/tris = renderer.info per frame at the chase pose (all passes); trees = InstancedMesh instances carrying aLodF; ring = horizon-forest instances; props = props-group InstancedMesh instances; grass = world-grass program instances built at sampling time (deferred chunks stream in, so it varies run to run); texMB/geoMB = scene texture / geometry byte estimates; programs = renderer.info.programs.length; ltEntry = long tasks during battle entry (max ms).
